name: Classic City 4 Charity 2017

venue.name: [Tate Student Center](http://tate.uga.edu/)
venue.details: Reception Hall - Room 0672 Right beside the stairs on the 1st floor.

information:
**4x4 is the main event of this competition!**
For the registration fee, we will be collecting toys of $15 value or $30 in cash prior to competing.
Once you register for the competition, your registration will be approved.
Day 1 for this competition will be in the Reception Hall at Tate.
Day 2 for this competition will be held in the MLC Room 207.
Please see the venue tab for more details.
